mods.name: Starer

releases.notes:
Client-side Fabric mod for **Minecraft 1.21.8**. Look at a mob, press **V**, and your view follows it.

## Install

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) 0.16.0 or newer and download [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 1.21.8
2. Drop both `fabric-api-0.136.1+1.21.8.jar` and `mc-starer-1.2.0.jar` below into your `.minecraft/mods` folder
3. Launch Minecraft with the Fabric profile

`config/mc-starer.json` is written with defaults on first launch. [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) is optional and adds a cog button for the settings screen.

## Requirements

Minecraft 1.21.8 - Java 21 or newer - Fabric Loader 0.16.0+ - Fabric API

Client-side only: no server-side component, so it works on any server you can already join.
